definition.description:
Calibrate the light path of every active detector: its pixel-to-stage transform.

The stage moves in x only, then in y only, at a fixed focus, by as much as shifts the image
by `SHIFT_OF_FRAME`; the image shifts give the pixel scale (rotation and flip included),
stored per light path for the frames acquired through it. The stage ends where it started.
definition.name: Calibrate Light Path

children.description: Shared state for affine transformation parameters.

Of what changes where a pixel looks: this matrix holds for as long as it does

definition.description:
Scan a rectangular region of the stage tile by tile.

The region from (start_x, start_y) to (end_x, end_y) (stage micrometres) is covered
with fields of view of the detector (`detector_name`, else the first active one),
overlapping by `overlap`, visited in `scan_order`; every active detector acquires a
frame at each tile.
definition.name: Scan Region

definition.description:
Acquire times x positions x planes x channels, into one dataset per position.

Each time it visits each position, then each plane of the stack, and every channel sets what it
sets and its detectors take their images; hooks run at the start (`m_hooks`), each time
(`t_hooks`), at each position (`p_hooks`) and at each plane (`z_hooks`).
definition.name: Acquire
